corrections.reason: The printed glyph in ትእግሥትን is ግ (with a slightly faded left leg), which Stage 1 misread as ዕ.
Classical Ge'ez patristic citation 'እስመ እሙንቱ መለክዋ በርስት መለኮታዊት' (3rd pl. Masc. Perfect of መለከ with 3rd sg. Fem. Object suffix -ዋ: መለክዋ). The 6th-order ክ was misread as ኮ.

corrections.old_text: ሐዊ ፡ ባሕታዊ ፡ ነው ፡ ፩ ፡ እሆ ፡ በሀሊ ፡
corrections.corrected_text: ሐዊ ፡ ባሕታዊ ፡ ነው ፡ ፩ ፡ እወ ፡ በሀሊ ፡
corrections.reason: The standard Ge'ez compound for an obedient disciple is 'እወ በሀሊ' (one who says 'yes'). The printed glyph is clearly ወ, misread as ሆ.
The printed word is ዠመር ('ይነቅል ዠመር' - he began to uproot/pluck). Stage 1 split the two-legged ዠ into ገቦ.
